en: The postcard displays a sepia-toned view of prominent buildings and a park-like area. The buildings are classical European stone structures. The text on the front identifies the location as Sundsvall, showing the Sparbanken (Savings Bank) and Sveateatern (Svea Theater). The reverse side includes a handwritten message in Swedish, a 10 öre Swedish stamp depicting a historical figure, and the printed information of Sundsvall and Stockholm. The address is written to a recipient in Norrviken.
